newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA NAMES SHADOW SQUAD FOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA NAMES SHADOW SQUAD FOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Athletics South Africa on Thursday announced a squad of 26 athletes to prepare for the International Amateur Athletics Federation (IAAF) World Championships in Athens in August.

"We will carefully monitor the athletes' form in training as well as competition in various major meetings in Europe during June and July," ASA secretary general Banele Sindani told a news conference.
"But we sincerely hope that the only reason for anyone to pull out of this squad will be for injury and not lack of form."
The athletes will be based at a training camp in Tata, Hungary, in preparation for the championships from July 4.
Sindani said that the final team would be selected on July 20, with the same date also the cut off for athletes not in the squad to achiev the IAAF qualifying standards.

Elana Meyer has been entered for the 5000 metres and 10,000 metres and will make a late choice which one to compete in. The same is the case for Gwen Griffiths who has been entered in both the 1500 metres and the 5000 metres.
A marathon squad has already left for Albuquerque, New Mexico, to take part in a specialised training camp.

Squad: Arnhaud Malherbe (400m), Hezekiel Sepeng (800m), Marius van Heerden (800m), Llewellyn Herbert (400m hurdles), Riaan Botha (pole vault), Okkert Brits (pole vault), Burger Lambrechts (shot put), Marius Corbett (javelin), Hendrik Mokganyetsi (400m and 800m), Hendrik Ramaala (10,000m), Chris Britz (20km walk), Liod Kgopong (400m), Adri de Jongh (200m and 400m), Gwen Griffiths (1500m or 5000m), Colleen de Reuck (10,000m), Elana Meyer (5000m or 10,000m), Sanet Fouche (long jump), Hestrie Storbeck (hig jump).
Marathon team: Lawrence Peu, Xolile Yawa, Martin Ndhiveni, Abner Chipu, Nixon Nkodima, Adam Mokibe, Grace de Oliveira, Rita Toto.
